model: local-mac / oMLX Qwen3.8-27B (live); deterministic frames use scripted fake state

mechanisms.deterministic: capture/capture-deterministic.mjs renders the REAL vendored SettingsPanel, RunningView, PeekView and the delegate tool's renderResult with a scripted fake-state timeline and a deterministic ANSI theme; no model, reproducible.
mechanisms.live: capture/capture-isolated.sh runs a REAL pi in an isolated PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR (published delegate stripped) with the dev source loaded project-locally, drives the screens in tmux, captures true-color. Does not touch the live install.
mechanisms.session-export: real-session.html via `pi --export` of a real delegating child session (type session v3).

S1-home.mustShow: title 'Delegation'; health summary (version·mode, active/idle, last); Actions incl. Run general/research, Peek, Cancel (disabled when idle), Resume, strict toggle, 'Configure advanced… ›', Doctor, Paths; base Timeouts (user hard/idle, project); shortcut footer; borders intact at 80/62/20; no input-bar smear.

S2-home-live.mustShow: Live section: Phase (accent) · shortModel; fixed progress bar % of hard; Tokens ↑in ↓out (primary) · $cost (muted, secondary); In flight tool; tail event; Cancel enabled while active.

S4-inline-strip.mustShow: FIXED height (no height change between frames); header role·shortModel·elapsed·turn·↑↓tokens; progress bar; in-flight (warning); ≥1 feed line; 'esc/q cancel (press twice)' footer; borders valid incl. width 20; color inner-text only.

S6-peek.mustShow: overlay fixed 20 rows; full model id in header; scrollable event feed with +Ns relative stamps; live/final mode label; 'q close'; returns to home/dashboard.

S7-advanced.mustShow: knobs: queueLimit, stuck-tool watchdog, kill grace, handoff grace/enforce, max task/result bytes, default role (info); editable inputs right-aligned; opened from 'Configure advanced…'; esc returns home.

S8-cancel-confirm.mustShow: framed confirm: question 'Cancel active run?'; consequence line (SIGTERM→SIGKILL, partial handoff); Yes/No choice highlighted (not color-alone); default not destructive-accidental.

S9-doctor.mustShow: diagnostic checks with ✓/⚠/✗ glyph+word (never color-alone): node, child-mode, store, config timeouts (hard/idle/stuck), model server reachability, recent runs, handoff mode.

S9-paths.mustShow: config path, runs dir, sessions dir, last run + transcript paths.

S5-toolpath.surface: MODEL path — delegate tool renderCall/renderResult (the reported-broken surface)
S5-toolpath.mustShow: during: live strip with in-flight + tail; done: neutral card '✓ done' with ↑↓tokens · $cost · shortModel; cancelled: '⊘ cancelled' (NOT a bare 'error:') with partial-handoff tail + resume hint; timeout would render 'timeout · idle/hard' warning. Proves the model path no longer emits bare error:.

demo.gif.mustShow: ordered live sequence: home dashboard → run → inline strip frames (feed filling) → peek → cancel-confirm.

real-session.html.mustShow: Pi's own HTML export of a real child session that delegated: tool calls, handoff, final result.

invariants.widths: every render(width) line visibleWidth ≤ width at 80/62/20; borders valid at width 1
invariants.fixed-height: RunningView 9 rows and PeekView 20 rows never change between refreshes (no composer/input-bar smear)
invariants.timers: refresh timers cleared on overlay close and session_shutdown
